name: rosetta-golden-ratio-convergence
code:
use IO.Std.write_line
use System.Math.abs
use System.Math.sqrt

let target = (1.0D + sqrt(5.0D)) / 2.0D

let ratio mut = 1.0D
let iterations mut = 0

let converged mut = false

while !converged do
    let following = 1.0D + 1.0D / ratio

    converged = abs(following - ratio) <= 1.0e-5D
    ratio = following
    iterations = iterations + 1
od

write_line("phi is {ratio:F12} after {iterations} iterations")
write_line("the error against (1 + sqrt 5) / 2 is {ratio - target:E6}")
